Hot take 🔥

If your Google review rating is below 4.5 stars, running ads is a waste of money.

Here's why:

82% of consumers say they won't use a business with less than 4-star reviews.

And 3 out of 4 people check reviews BEFORE visiting a local business.

You can spend $5,000/month on ads and drive thousands of people to your listing...

...but if your reputation isn't there, they'll leave and go to your competitor.

Reputation first. Ads second. Always.
